summary: Fix structured-output Mermaid repair, strict grounding, and stable model-output issue codes.
final_report: Implemented T5a structured-output correctness changes. (1) request_output now accepts an optional async semantic_validator; for output_kind=mermaid the normalized draft.source is validated via validate_mermaid inside the two-attempt repair loop, diagram_type is captured and returned as a 3-tuple (draft, attempt, diagram_type), a mermaid_validator_unavailable failure propagates immediately with no repair, and exhaustion raises a retryable ModelOutputError with stable issue code mermaid_invalid (not prose). (2) _validation_detail preserves coded ModelOutputError issue codes (invalid_json, trailing_data, ...) and maps uncoded failures to stable codes (empty_text, duplicate_options, correct_index_out_of_range, quiz_count, quiz_shape, unsupported_output_kind, invalid_output); it never emits str(exc) prose as an issue code. (3) StructuredOutputService.generate adds a strict-grounding guard: strict + no selected/ready chunks raises a retryable ModelOutputError with issue code insufficient_context before any LLM call; Mermaid content is built from the diagram_type captured during repair (validate_mermaid runs exactly once, no re-validation). (4) Focused tests: mermaid repair-on-first-invalid, mermaid exhaustion (retryable mermaid_invalid), mermaid validator-unavailable propagation (single LLM call), strict-no-chunks skips LLM and returns insufficient_context, stable issue codes for invalid/trailing JSON and empty/duplicate quiz options, and mermaid diagram_type plumbing end-to-end. Verification: ruff clean (zero issues); focused pytest tests/test_structured_outputs.py + tests/test_api_outputs.py = 18 passed; related smoke (test_mermaid.py + test_structured.py) = 27 passed. Full-suite verification handed to Merlin.
